Sql:
SELECT p."Unitate" AS "UnitateId", p."Cont" AS "ContId", p."Repartitor" AS "PartenerId", min(p."UnitateDeschisa") AS "Deschisa", COALESCE(sum(CASE
    WHEN p."Sens" = 1 THEN p."Valoare"
    ELSE 0.0
END), 0.0) AS "Debit", COALESCE(sum(CASE
    WHEN p."Sens" = 2 THEN p."Valoare"
    ELSE 0.0
END), 0.0) AS "Credit"
FROM "Postare" AS p
WHERE (p."Contrapondere" <> 4 OR p."Contrapondere" IS NULL) AND p."Spatiu" = 1 AND p."Carte" = 1 AND p."FelUnitate" = 2 AND p."Unitate" IS NOT NULL AND p."Repartitor" IS NOT NULL AND p."UnitateDeschisa" IS NOT NULL AND p."Data" <= @panaLa
GROUP BY p."Unitate", p."Cont", p."Repartitor"
ORDER BY p."Unitate"
LIMIT @p
